## Summary

Describe the user-visible or architectural change and why it is needed.

## Implementation status

- [ ] Implemented behavior is distinguished from planned behavior.
- [ ] Unsupported capabilities remain explicitly unavailable/nonconformant.
- [ ] Material third-party dependencies have documented provenance, license, and boundaries.

## Validation

- [ ] `gofmt` clean
- [ ] `go vet ./...`
- [ ] `go test ./...`
- [ ] `go build ./cmd/swarmd`
- [ ] Security/privacy implications reviewed
- [ ] Destructive or externally reachable behavior has explicit authorization controls

## Documentation

- [ ] `FEATURES.md` reflects actual state when feature behavior changes.
- [ ] `FEATURE-ROADMAP.md` reflects roadmap changes when applicable.
- [ ] `SECURITY.md` / `PRIVACY POLICY.md` updated when boundaries change.
- [ ] `goreecloud.platform.yaml` remains truthful.
- [ ] Canonical GoreeCloud documentation/changelog reconciliation identified when required.
